context: This criteria evaluates how well the engineer uses babel-plugin-react-compiler's configuration API to implement a monitoring tool. It assesses proficiency with the plugin's logger interface, options configuration, and compilation mode settings.

checklist.name: Logger configuration
checklist.description: Correctly configures the 'logger' option in the plugin options with a 'logEvent' function that accepts filename and event parameters.

checklist.name: Success event handling
checklist.description: Handles 'CompileSuccess' events from the logger by extracting the function name (fnName field) and tracking it in the statistics.

checklist.name: Error event handling
checklist.description: Handles 'CompileError' or 'CompileDiagnostic' events from the logger and tracks error file paths in the statistics.

checklist.name: Compilation mode option
checklist.description: Correctly configures the 'compilationMode' option in the plugin options, accepting either 'infer' or 'all' as specified in the MonitorConfig.

checklist.name: File filtering option
checklist.description: Correctly configures the 'sources' option in the plugin options with the provided fileFilter function to control which files are compiled.

checklist.name: Plugin return format
checklist.description: Returns the plugin in the correct Babel plugin array format: [pluginFunction, optionsObject], where pluginFunction is the default export from babel-plugin-react-compiler.
